comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: There appears to be some confusion about what this ship skill does. Well, when you sail into an area where the waves are higher then your ships Wave Resistance (WR), there's a chance you're be hit by a broadside wave. Having this ship skill protects you 90% of the time from that happening. Hiring an aide with the Breakwater skill also does the same thing, as well as naturally increasing your ships WR through modding. It does NOT give a hidden bonus value to your ships WR, nor does it boost your acceleration or top speed.
